text.texturebuilder.config.title: PA9 TextureBuilder — Hotbar Pool
text.texturebuilder.config.weight.toolti: Relative share of placements for this slot (0-100). Drag to adjust, or select the slider and use the arrow keys for exact values. Weights are normalized against the other included slots, so they need not add up to 100.
text.texturebuilder.config.reset_weights: Set every slot's weight back to the default (10). Included slots are not changed.
text.texturebuilder.config.mode.tooltip: Texture: weighted random pick from the included slots. Gradient: the block's position between the gradient start and end points picks the block. Each mode has its own Included slots.
text.texturebuilder.gradient.included.to: Include this slot in the gradient. Included slots run from the start point to the end point in hotbar order (left to right).
text.texturebuilder.gradient.need_two: Include at least 2 slots for a gradient
text.texturebuilder.gradient.distributio: Drag a handle to change how much of the start-to-end line each block owns. Handles can't pass each other. Keyboard: Enter/Space picks the next handle, Left/Right moves it (Shift for bigger steps).
Blend width around each boundary. 0%: hard bands. 100%: each block fades fully into the next.
text.texturebuilder.gradient.reset.toolt: Spread the included blocks evenly along the line again.
text.texturebuilder.gradient.points.none: Points: not set (bind "Set Gradient Point" in Controls)
text.texturebuilder.gradient.points.same: Start %s, end %s: start and end are the same
message.texturebuilder.gradient.same: Gradient start and end are the same
message.texturebuilder.gradient.no_targe: Look at a block to set a gradient point
message.texturebuilder.failed: Texture Builder hit an error and is disabled for this session (see log)
